scenes.summary: Breathing in the haze lets you see certain symbols that seem to be associated with the mechanisms blocking your way. Perlica recommends using the haze and symbols to find a way through the mechanisms.

lines.text: Can there be any connections between these mechanisms ... and those ⟦key|symbols⟧?
The ⟦key|symbols⟧ suddenly appeared on the wall when we were in the haze...
The ⟦key|symbols⟧... Maybe we have to be affected by the haze to see them...

scenes.summary: At the gates of the Æther Test Site, you resolve to seal the rift looming overhead — and Tata is the key. With everything in place, it's time for the final showdown.

lines.text: The location of the rift is up ahead. There's a good chance that Nefarith is there.
Endmin, the purpose of our mission is not to defeat Nefarith or die trying. Our objective is to find a way to seal the rift.
That's why moving Tata to the epicenter of the rift will be a key challenge. I have an idea to make that happen...
Relax, Tata. We've survived so many dangers together and made it this far already. I'm sure this is going to end well.
You're right. Endfield once overcame tribulations far more terrible than this... Today, we shall fight alongside our Endministrator once again.
Make your final preparations. We shall restore peace to Valley IV.
The time has come to end this. Are you ready, Endmin?
I agree. We cannot afford any lapse for the final battle.

options: Don't worry. We'll help you complete your mission safely.
Have no fear. Leave it to us.
Not yet. Give me some time.
